title_zh: 維斯帕拉德 第 8 章
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
aêta vaca madhayangha
ahe vaca señdayangha
ahurô mazdå ashava hathra vanghubyô ýazataêibyô
ýat ameshaêibyô speñtaêibyô
huxshathraêibyô hudhâbyô pañcasatbîshca
satâishca hazangrâishca baêvarebîshca
ahãxshtâishca frâyebîshcatca ahmât.
segments.en:
With this word be Thou approached, with the proper word be
Thou present here, Thou who art Ahura Mazda, the holy, together
with the good Yazads who are the Bountiful Immortals, who rule
aright, and dispose (of all) aright, together with fifty, and
a hundred, and a thousand, and ten thousand, and millions, and
yet more.
segments.zh:
以此言，願祢被接近，以正當之言，願祢
祢在此處存在，祢即阿胡拉‧馬茲達，持阿沙的聖者，以及
以及善良的耶賽德，即大天神，誰統治
正確地，並正確處置（一切），以及五十，
一百，以及一千，以及一萬，以及百萬，
更多。

segments.orig:
huxshathrôtemâi bât xshathrem ahmat hyat
aibî dademahicâ ... ashâicâ vahishtâi.
(...huxshathrôtemâi ... vahishtâi(3)!!)
segments.en: And to Him who rules the best let the Kingdom be!
segments.zh: 以及讓祂誰統治最好，願王國存在！
